hypothesis.method: Neural Architecture Search with evolutionary constraints for dynamic prompt adaptation
hypothesis.problem: Generative AI models exhibit inconsistent performance across semantically similar prompts due to static architectural biases
hypothesis.goal: Automatically evolve transformer architectures that adapt structure in real-time to prompt complexity, improving generalization and reducing hallucination rates

messages.content: Propose one novel and scientifically valid research hypothesis in the field of artificial intelligence, in particular generative AI. Express it as three short phrases: a Method (the technique to be used), a Problem (the problem to be addressed), and a Goal (the property to be improved). Answer only with a JSON object of the form {"method": "...", "problem": "...", "goal": "..."} and nothing else.
